paper.title: AgenticRecTune: Multi-Agent with Self-Evolving Skillhub for Recommendation System Optimization
paper.central_claim: 五智能体以在线A/B反馈维护Pareto精英配置记忆和自演化Skillhub，自动优化推荐多阶段非权重配置，降低人工调参负担并提升多项线上指标。

provenance.notes: 派发 model type=sonnet，声明映射 gpt-6.1-sol；未独立探测模型，工具未提供可核验 actual_model/session/receipt，故为 null。未读另一席或其他 attempt；未运行收录代码。

sections_read: 6 Conclusion; no appendix present in fixed version

reason: 全文完整且对象为非权重配置与skills，非网络权重；可评价但自演化因果证据薄弱。
rationale: 在线A/B与Pareto记忆闭环具体，Skillhub会写回下轮；不过实验只证明选中配置优于生产基线，没有冻结Skillhub或预算匹配优化器对照，自主演化收益尚未隔离。

evidence.quote: Before online A/B testing starts, the users’ review is required.
evidence.support_explanation: 人类审核仍必需，限制不需任何人工的中心表述。

evidence.quote: this empirical performance data is then written back into the Agent Memory by updating the corresponding JSON files.
evidence.support_explanation: 在线结果写入持久记忆。

evidence.quote: elite task item will be read by the actor agent in the prompt generation in the next iteration of configuration optimizations.
evidence.support_explanation: 下一轮确实读取前轮留存配置。

evidence.quote: By archiving only these elite candidates, the Insight Agent ensures the memory remains lean yet high-performing.
evidence.support_explanation: 按在线指标及非支配关系保留精英；未给噪声稳健性检查。

evidence.quote: automatically appends these refined rules to the Domain Knowledge component of that skill. Simultaneously, it dynamically tightens the search space bounds within the Task Requirements.
evidence.support_explanation: 从历史结果提炼规则、调整搜索边界写回Skill。

evidence.quote: Live user traffic was randomly partitioned into orthogonal buckets.
evidence.support_explanation: 随机在线流量分桶，支持配置本身的A/B测量。

evidence.quote: Each experiment was run as a standard launch period to ensure statistical significance (evaluated at a p-value < 0.05).
evidence.support_explanation: 声明显著性阈值但无时长、样本量、方差或多重检验报告。

evidence.quote: diversity metric increases by 3.43% and engagement Metric 1 & 2 also increase.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者报告重排diversity及engagement结果，指标具体商业定义未公开。

evidence.quote: The Actor-Critic configuration achieved a 0.75% and 0.90% lift in engagement metric 1 and 2, respectively
evidence.support_explanation: 与单Actor策略的相关比较存在，但不等于Skillhub有效性检验。

evidence.quote: These playbooks undergo a continuous cycle of generation, reflection, and curation to systematically accumulate and refine strategic knowledge.
evidence.support_explanation: ACE是作者承认的直接可编辑playbook祖先。

evidence.quote: the agent learns patterns of primary metrics from multiple tasks in parallel (Map) followed by a global synthesis of patterns (Reduce).
evidence.support_explanation: 跨任务经验整合被描述但未独立测试。
